python/typeshed.title: `abc.ABC.__slots__` should be marked with `ClassVar`
python/typeshed.author: embecka
python/typeshed.body_preview: According to the [python official documentation](https://docs.python.org/3/reference/datamodel.html#slots), slots are class variables. Therefore, in the class `abc.ABC`, the variable `__slots__` should be annotated as `ClassVar[Sequence[str]]`. There is currently no annotation. It means that in all subclasses of `abc.ABC`, the variable `__slots__` is considered as an instance variable.
